Problems 5–14 and 21–30 are word problems ("Your grandmother gave you $16…").
Argon does not solve word problems — it needs an answer key or AI assist for
those. This file happens to *be* the key, so their answers are already printed
on it.

### If you want this one as a study deck
Get the plain **worksheet** version from your teacher (the one with no answers).
It'll import clean and Argon will solve all 28 equations for you. The word
problems will still come in as flashcards — you just won't get an auto‑answer
on them.
